answer:
**Jargon File entry (canonical)**

**yak shaving**  
[MIT AI Lab, after 2000: orig. probably from a Ren & Stimpy episode.] Any seemingly pointless activity which is actually necessary to solve a problem which solves a problem which, several levels of recursion later, solves the real problem you're working on.

Source: The Jargon File, catb.org — http://catb.org/jargon/html/Y/yak-shaving.html

**Related results (concise sourcing)**

1. **Same entry, mirror** — Identical wording on underpop.free.fr jargon mirror. Source: http://underpop.free.fr/j/jargon/y/yak-shaving.html

2. **Index pointer** — ZVON lists “yak shaving” under The Jargon File Glossary and links the online file (v4.4.7) at catb.org. Source: https://zvon.org/comp/m/yak_shaving.html

3. **Origin account** — Coined at the MIT AI Lab in the 1990s by Carlin J. Vieri after a *Ren & Stimpy* “Yak Shaving Day” bit; Jeremy H. Brown’s Feb 2000 all-ai post is an early written definition of the long causal chain of fiddly tasks. The Jargon File’s wording is described as cautious but broadly right. Source: https://www.levellers.ai/what-is/yak-shaving

4. **TechTarget** — “Seemingly endless series of small tasks” before the next project step; credits Vieri and *Ren & Stimpy*. Source: https://www.techtarget.com/whatis/definition/yak-shaving

5. **Stack Exchange (Software Engineering)** — Nested prerequisites needed to reach the original goal; can be neutral (necessary path) or negative (distraction). Source: https://softwareengineering.stackexchange.com/questions/388092/what-exactly-is-yak-shaving

6. **DEV Community** — MIT-lab origin; subtasks that look unrelated but are required (e.g., dependency → Node → nvm before a React component). Source: https://dev.to/cerchie/tech-jargon-defined-what-is-yak-shaving-3hj8

7. **ITBroker glossary** — Recursive prerequisite chain (firewall → window → ticket → account, and so on). Source: https://www.itbroker.com/resources/glossary/yak-shaving

8. **Visual Thesaurus (2014)** — Annoying succession of tasks before the real goal; cites Vieri and the Jargon File’s *Ren & Stimpy* link. Source: https://www.visualthesaurus.com/cm/wc/heavy-lifting-and-shaving-yaks-corporate-lingo/

# yak shaving

The tedious tasks that must be done before productive work can begin, "yak shaving" may also refer to useless activity one engages in to avoid real work.

The term originate around the year 2000 at [MIT](https://www.netlingo.com/word/mit.php) by way of "Yak Shaving Day" an early-1990s segment from the animated series,

_Ren & Stimpy_

.
